# departs.app

**departs.app** is a lightning-fast, real-time public transit tracker for Prague (PID) and Brno (IDS JMK). It provides users with live departures, vehicle locations, and dynamic route tracking on an interactive map.

## Core Features

- **Live Departures**: Real-time departure boards for all stops (Metro, Trams, Buses, Trains).
- **Interactive Map**: Live vehicle locations with accurate delay information and route tracking.
- **Smart Search**: Quick stop and station discovery.
- **Supported Regions**: Prague Integrated Transport (PID) and South Moravian Region (IDS JMK).

## AI Capabilities & Remote MCP Server

This application hosts a native **Remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server** at `https://departs.app/mcp`. AI assistants (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, ChatGPT) can connect directly to real-time transit data over Server-Sent Events (SSE) or Streamable HTTP POST.

Exposed MCP Tools:

- **`search_stops`**: Search stops/stations by name or ID in Prague (PID) or Brno (IDS JMK).
- **`search_nearest_stops`**: Find public transit stops/stations closest to geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude).
- **`get_next_departures`**: Real-time departure board for any stop, including inline stop notice Banners/Infotexts, delays, headsigns, and accessibility info.
- **`get_nearest_departures`**: Real-time departures for stops closest to geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude), with optional route_type filter (bus, tram, metro, train).
- **`get_realtime_vehicles`**: Live vehicle GPS positions, line numbers, delays, and tracking status.
- **`get_service_alerts`**: Active transit disruptions, closures, detours, and news alerts.
- **`get_vehicle_detail`**: Trip itinerary, stop schedule progress, and vehicle specs.

### MCP Integration URLs
- **Remote MCP Endpoint**: `https://departs.app/mcp` (SSE / Streamable HTTP)
- **MCP Metadata Specification**: `https://departs.app/.well-known/mcp.json`

## URL Structure

For direct navigation or linking, the app uses the following routing structures:
- **Map Home**: `https://departs.app/{city}` (e.g., `https://departs.app/prague`)
- **Stop Detail**: `https://departs.app/{city}/stop/{stopId}` (e.g., `https://departs.app/prague/stop/U850Z1P`)
- **Vehicle/Trip Tracking**: `https://departs.app/{city}/trip/{tripId}` (e.g., `https://departs.app/brno/trip/12345`)

## Tech Stack

- **Frontend**: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind v4, Zustand, MapLibre GL JS
- **Backend & Edge APIs**: Cloudflare Pages Functions
- **Source**: https://github.com/joseph5610/departs-app
